skills.name: Monodrama
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sparkle's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Dreamdiver
skills.desc:
Increases the CRIT DMG of a single target ally by #1[f1]% of Sparkle's CRIT DMG plus #2[f1]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s). And at the same time, Advances Forward this ally's action by #4[i]%.
When Sparkle uses this ability on herself, the Action Advance effect will not trigger.

skills.name: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
skills.desc: Recovers #2[i] Skill Points for the team and grants all allies Cipher. For allies with Cipher, each stack of the DMG Boost effect provided by Sparkle's Talent additionally increases by #3[f1]%, lasting for #4[i] turns.

skills.name: Red Herring
skills.desc: While Sparkle is on the battlefield, additionally increases the max number of Skill Points by #3[i]. Whenever an ally consumes 1 Skill Point, all allies' DMG dealt increases by #2[f1]%. This effect lasts for #1[i] turn(s) and can stack up to #4[i] time(s).

skills.name: Unreliable Narrator
skills.desc: After using Technique, grants all allies Misdirect for #2[i] seconds. Characters with Misdirect will not be detected by enemies, and entering combat in the Misdirect state recovers #1[i] Skill Point(s) for the team.

passives.name: Almanac
passives.desc: When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.

passives.name: Artificial Flower
passives.desc: The CRIT DMG Boost effect provided by the Skill will be extended until the start of the target's next turn.

passives.name: Nocturne
passives.desc: Increases all allies' ATK by 15%. When there are 1/2/3 Quantum-Type allies in the team, additionally increases Quantum-Type allies' ATK by 5%/15%/30%.
